icons.name: cloud
icons.heading: Cloud
icons.description: The wind blows the cloud. Light: two speed lines streak in from the left above it, one after the other, and fade; the gust shoves the cloud right, and it drifts back with one small rebound. Strong: two gusts in turn: the lines streak twice and the cloud is shoved twice, further the second time, before it drifts back and settles.

icons.name: sun
icons.heading: Sun
icons.description: The sun comes out. Light: a wave of light runs clockwise from the top ray: each ray pulls back into the disc and shines out again in turn, and the disc swells once as the light goes out. Strong: the rays shine out past their length and spring back in turn while the ring of rays turns a little with the light and springs back, and the disc swells harder.

icons.name: compass
icons.heading: Compass
